provincial.name: Manitoba Prenatal Benefit
provincial.who: Pregnant Manitoba residents with net family income under $32,000; apply during pregnancy with a note confirming it
provincial.what: Monthly income supplement for six months, up to $162.82/month; does not affect income assistance
provincial.route: application form by mail with pregnancy note
provincial.reason: Low-income benefit, not disability specific; marginal fit for family scope

provincial.name: Rent Supplement (Manitoba Housing)
provincial.who: Household income below CMHC Program Income Limits, permanent legal resident, 18+, no other shelter allowance; targets low-income, seniors, special needs households
provincial.what: Province pays gap between rent-geared-to-income amount and market rent in private/non-profit units
provincial.route: application from Manitoba Housing leasing office or non-profit; 204-945-3131
provincial.reason: Not in built list; only 'accessible/adapted social housing' draft exists. Disability not required explicitly.

provincial.name: Manitoba Housing Social Housing Rental Program (RGI)
provincial.who: Low-income individuals, seniors, families; sponsor-managed and non-profit streams include people with disabilities. Detailed eligibility page (pil.html) not fetched
provincial.what: Subsidized rent in Manitoba Housing units, rent geared to income
provincial.reason: Overview page only; income limits page not fetched, may overlap draft 'accessible/adapted social housing' record

provincial.name: Employability Assistance for People with Disabilities (EAPD) / Vocational Rehabilitation
provincial.who: Manitoba resident 16+ with intellectual, psychiatric, learning or physical disability, legally entitled to work permanently, willing to seek and keep work
provincial.what: Vocational counselling, vocational plan, supported employment and training via designated agencies
provincial.reason: Disability employment program, in scope, not in built list

provincial.name: Seniors' School Tax Rebate
provincial.reason: Age-based, not disability; optional low-income seniors item

provincial.name: Affordable Energy Program (Efficiency Manitoba, formerly Manitoba Hydro)
provincial.what: Free/subsidized insulation, furnace and efficiency upgrades
provincial.reason: hydro.mb.ca/aep returned 404; official Efficiency Manitoba page not found; unverified, search says program moved to Efficiency Manitoba and funding status unclear

provincial.name: Northern Patient Transportation Program
provincial.who: Manitoba residents north of 53rd/51st parallel with health card; travel for insured services unavailable locally
provincial.what: Subsidy for medical travel and escort
provincial.reason: Official gov.mb.ca page not fetched (northernhealthregion.com 404, brochure PDF unreadable); geographic, not disability; low priority

municipal.name: Brandon Access Transit
municipal.who: People with disabilities unable to use regular transit: need mobility aid, visual impairment, cannot manage 40 cm step or walk 200 m unaided; doctor-signed Form 1/2 and 2/2
municipal.what: Door-to-door rides, fares match regular Brandon Transit; Mon-Sat 6am-midnight, Sun 9am-7pm; book 204-729-2437
